liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.
Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.

Deposits must call the vault’s deposit with raw L, exact currency maximums, a reviewed receipt recipient and inclusive deadline. The vault itself owns the core position; external router-owned LP additions/removals/pokes are forbidden. Withdrawals burn the holder’s own L receipts and deliver principal only to that holder.

Check actual hook-owned position liquidity equals totalSupply, the immutable tick range and salt, exact token intake/principal delivery and separate harvested-fee reserves. An out-of-range position can be one-sided; one raw receipt unit is one core liquidity L, not token value, dollars or ERC4626 assets.

Review the receipt transfer semantics: already harvested/indexed fee debt stays with its earned holder; unharvested core fees follow the transferred shares. A holder may harvest before transferring if that distinction matters. Anyone can trigger indexed fee claims only to the named holder. Rounding residue stays reserved, with no arbitrary dust rescue.

definition.help: This pool accepts one vault-owned immutable-range LP position. Fungible QRL receipts have 0 decimals: one raw receipt equals one actual core L unit. Receipt transfers settle indexed fee rights; unharvested fees travel with the shares. Deposits/withdrawals harvest before changing supply. Ordinary swaps and donations use the configured pool fee and price; a deposit does not rebalance or protect value. Not ERC4626, a rebalancer, dollar shares, guaranteed yield or inferred end-wallet ownership. Exact plain assets and fixed-recipient fee/principal delivery require live review.
